assessment: This valuable study significantly enhances our understanding of how various ligands and receptors interact within the Notch signaling pathway. By developing novel cell-based assay systems, the authors systematically analyzed the effects of different ligand-receptor combinations on pathway activation. The convincing data reveal intriguing and unexpected differences and provide a foundation for interpreting Notch signalling in both normal and disease-related contexts.
